metadata.title: my-agents
metadata.description: Frontend console for the my-agents FastAPI + LangGraph service

home.title: A real AI-agent console, wired to the backend service.
home.description: Manage authenticated conversations, server-owned transcripts, agent runs, citations, documents, groups, and knowledge workflows without using the legacy smoke chat endpoint.
featureCards: Greet-style services, query keys, models, and keymesh components.
Next BFF route handlers protect session and CSRF forwarding.
Implementation log keeps the work followable for future manual edits.

auth.heroDescription: Authenticate into a FastAPI + LangGraph backend, run real conversation workflows, and inspect citations, documents, groups, and safe agent activity.
features: Conversation runs, not legacy smoke chat.
auth.signupDescription: Create an account, then log in with the same credentials.
auth.loginDescription: Use the backend auth session to enter the console.
auth.signupSuccessDescription: We created {email}. You can now log in with this account.
auth.guestDescription: Continue with a 24-hour guest session: one chat, up to 5 prompts, and up to 3 document uploads. The backend enforces these limits.

chat.title: Chat
chat.noActiveConversationDescription: Create a conversation to unlock the chat composer.
chat.streamingComposerPlaceholder: Type a follow-up — Enter queues it after this answer.
chat.queuedComposerPlaceholder: Edit or cancel the queued message before adding another follow-up.
chat.sendNowHelper: Enter queues your follow-up. Send now stops the current answer first, then sends this message.
chat.sendNowWaitingForRun: Waiting for the backend run id before this answer can be stopped.
chat.sendNowQueuedBlocked: Edit or cancel the queued message before sending a different message now.
chat.queuedHelper: Will send after the current answer finishes.
chat.queuedAfterFailureHelper: The current answer failed. Send this queued message manually, edit it, or cancel it.
chat.guestPromptLimitHelper: Guest demo limits are backend-owned; queued and immediate messages still count when accepted.
chat.queuedAnnouncement: Message queued to send after the current answer.
chat.queueEditAnnouncement: Queued message moved back to the composer.
chat.queueAlreadyExistsAnnouncement: A queued message already exists. Edit or cancel it first.
chat.stoppingCurrentAnswerAnnouncement: Stopping the current answer before sending your message.
chat.currentAnswerStoppingAnnouncement: Backend accepted the stop request. Waiting for the current answer to close.
chat.immediateFailedAnnouncement: Could not stop the current answer. Your message was restored to the composer.
chat.noRunsDescription: Send a message to create the first run.
chat.noEventsDescription: Latest run events will appear here.
chat.noCitationsDescription: RAG citations appear when retrieved context is used.
chat.guestNoticeDescription: This guest session lasts 24 hours and is limited to one chat, 5 prompts, and 3 document uploads. If you hit a limit, the backend will return a safe error here.

common.emptyListDescription: Create one from the form above.

knowledge.title: Knowledge bases
knowledge.description: Create and list personal or group retrieval scopes.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Manage text documents, PDF uploads, ingestion, extraction runs, and direct permission patches.
documents.contentHint: The backend stores content and deterministic ingestion creates chunks/entities.
documents.permissionLabel: Grant read permission to user id
documents.permissionHint: Backend currently exposes an ID-based permission contract. User search should be a backend request if needed.
documents.pdfUploadHint: Backend Phase 2 accepts multipart PDF uploads at /documents/upload. Text-based PDFs are supported in V1.
documents.deleteDescription: Remove the selected uploaded or text document when ingestion produced bad data. This cannot be undone.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Create/list groups and manage member roles through the backend ID-based membership routes.
groups.noSelectedDescription: Create or select a group first.
groups.backendNote: Backend currently exposes ID-based member operations. If user search or member listing is needed, add a backend request before changing ../my-agents.
